fields.Name: IT157 - Chief of Staff Core Layers
fields.Description: Deterministic proof of the Chief of Staff's MJ-core layers, with no LLM calls and no Open App dependency: ownership guards on agent policies and agent requests, Run User Routine Now, AgentUserPolicyEngine cache sync, email approval-before-transport, typed core actions + Assemble My Briefing + zero raw SQL/generic CRUD, offered rhythms & declined suggestion dedup, Agent Channels loop-guard & human-intervention reset, and the code-enforced recurring routine gate.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All COS1-COS12 checks pass: ownership guards hold, run-now respects ownership and preserves schedule, policy cache tracks saves, email approvals queue before transport, Chief of Staff holds zero raw SQL/CRUD, Assemble My Briefing/Rhythms/Suggestions/Agent Channels enforce every guardrail, and autonomous recurring routine creation without confirmation returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
